scope: Training-only opt-in proposal score comparison; frozen selected pairs and source-then-state target; no PPO or validation fitting
conditional_law: Uniform source, then uniform locked eligible cases within source
zero_component_mass: Use P for that component before mixing
later_actions: Unchanged natural NDE; only initial decision is tilted
fixed_budget: Every locked eligible training case including zero-event cases; no substitutions or outcome-dependent extension. All three proposals share the case-indexed 64-seed block, different cases use disjoint blocks. Shared seeds are a pairing device, not independent replications across candidates.
